reason: All four P1 deliverables (SRS.md, SPEC_TRACKING.md, TRACEABILITY_MATRIX.md, TEST_INVENTORY.yaml) form a coherent requirements baseline for taskq. The 5 FRs and 10 NFRs in SRS.md §3-§4 are each represented in SPEC_TRACKING.md (FR side), fully expanded into the TRACEABILITY_MATRIX.md §2-§3 requirement matrices, and materialised as 63 individually enumerated test cases in TEST_INVENTORY.yaml (7+7+7+6+8 FRs and 1+2+3+3+1+3+5+3+3+4 NFRs), matching the 63 IDs declared in matrix §5 and the by_fr_total=63/by_layer_total=63 invariants in the inventory. No terminology drift across `taskq`, `TASKQ_HOME`, the `pending/running/done/failed/timeout` lifecycle, the `OPEN/HALF_OPEN/CLOSED` breaker states, `TASKQ_*` env vars, sha256(command) cache keys, p95, atomic-write, or `version: 1` schema. Acceptance
